smell_validity.evidence: Four internally cross-referenced families (signal shutdown, digest mail, manifest re-keying, suffix-tag filter) model residue from completed mechanism swaps. Each is unreachable yet exports-looking, so the boundary against a real public API is sharply drawn. A coherent dead-code story without competing problems; just short of reference-quality.

maintenance_impact.evidence: Four fake-but-credible mechanisms across packages obscure what each truly owns; readers cannot distinguish residue from a live feature without deep tracing. Engineers may extend retired digest mail, call SquashManifestEntries expecting current behavior, or reuse the suffix filter. Removing restores clearer long-term ownership boundaries beyond mere local edit.

development_plausibility.evidence: Fits recognizable conventions: drained-loop shutdown, migration2-idiom re-keying, fixed-string digest rendering, suffix filter between Tags and SortTags. Real app objects anchor each family. But the parallel paired structure (entry+helper, consumer+predicate, renderer+subject) across clusters is mild task-shaped regularity, short of indistinguishable repository evolution.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: An exceptional contract: it decisively steers against wrong direction (trace references, not names/exportedness; family whose only callers are its own members is residue), incomplete cleanup (remove whole families incl. private helpers and orphaned imports), and irrelevant redesign (no new deps, no rewrites, smallest change, no new call sites). It preserves room by naming responsibility areas, not symbols.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Four purposes across distinct areas: shutdown lifecycle, digest mail pipeline, manifest re-keying, tag filtering. Each demands different reasoning about which path is the real entry and which neighbors are residue. Different anchor symbols and live neighbors per family; but the underlying repair decision (delete the unreachable cluster) is uniform.

localization_burden.evidence: The digest family spans three packages and shares template infrastructure with the live per-entry config-selected notification path; distinguishing them requires excluding live template plumbing. Plus plausible-looking live companions (migration2, Send, Tags/SortTags) in each family's file must be held. Configuration selection plus cross-component combination are present.

repair_coordination.evidence: Within the digest cluster, dropping one member leaves dangling references in other files (drop RunDigest but leave renderDigestMail). Shared rule: remove-cluster-in-toto plus clean orphaned imports. No behavioral cross-stage producer/consumer rule; failure is a local compile break, not runtime mismatch.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: Static call-graph reachability analysis (U1000-style iterative drop) uniformly catches all four clusters: unexported helpers cascade after their anchor drops, and exported dead symbols in the main module are reportable. No per-location behavioral decisions; each cluster is already non-executing. The public-API boundary is uniform: all flagged symbols are additions, none pre-existing.

behavioral_risk.evidence: Several hidden failure paths via partial cleanup: leave a private helper after its anchor (termSignalReason, isArtifactSuffixTag, digestMailSubject) or leave digest RunDigest/RenderText after the renderer. The residue was never callable, so removing parts would not change observable behavior, leaving nothing to signal that residue persists.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
